task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Declare the public-health emergency, exercise executive authority to suspend normal procedure, and coordinate the overall response across all other offices.
Draft the emergency ordinances within hours: quarantine rules, burial protocols, market and port restrictions, and resource reallocation; submit them to the archon for ratification.
Enforce quarantine and cordon sanitaire, guard granaries and water supply, secure the movement of physicians and medical supplies between cities, and prevent flight that spreads contagion.
Communicate daily with the public through heralds: explain symptoms and isolation guidance, rebut misinformation, defuse panic, and rally compliance with the boule's measures.
